# slack-app_conversation_member (Resource)

Adds a user to a Slack channel with `conversations.invite`. Destroying the resource removes the user with `conversations.kick`. Requires the provider `bot_token`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) The ID of the public or private channel.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the workspace user to add to the channel.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
